novel_features.name: Clinical Queries refinement
novel_features.description: Refine a clinical or disease topic to therapy, diagnosis, etiology, prognosis, clinical-prediction, or systematic-review evidence, with open-access, evidence-level, and human/language/age scope filters.

novel_features.name: Article cards in one call
novel_features.description: Search and return clean article cards (title, authors, journal, date, DOI, PMID, evidence-level badge, optional abstract) with open-access and clinical scope filters, in one command.

novel_features.name: Abstract by PMID
novel_features.description: Fetch one or more abstracts by PMID as clean structured JSON or plain text.

novel_features.name: Publication trend
novel_features.description: Publication counts per year (or month) for a topic, ready to chart.

novel_features.name: What's new since last check
novel_features.description: Return only articles new since the last run of a saved query, using a local seen-PMID store.

novel_features.name: Saved queries
novel_features.description: Persist named queries with their filters, re-run them, and see when each last ran.

novel_features.name: Topic landscape
novel_features.description: Facet a query's top results by journal, author, year, or evidence level to show where the literature concentrates.

novel_features.name: PICO clinical question builder
novel_features.description: Compose a structured Patient/Intervention/Comparison/Outcome question into a precise PubMed query and run it.

novel_features.name: Two-term co-occurrence lens
novel_features.description: Track how often two terms (e.g. a drug and an adverse effect, or a disease and an intervention) appear together in the literature over time.
